title: How much of floating ice shows?
hook: Ice floats on water. But how much of a floating block actually rides above the line?

knows: that some things float and others sink
doesNotKnow: that a floating object sinks until it pushes aside its own weight of water
that about 92% of a floating ice block sits under fresh water

misconception: Ice floats because it is light, so most of it sits on top of the water (or about half).
objective: The learner can explain that ice at 0.917 g/cm³ floats with about 92% under fresh water and about 8% showing, because a floating block sinks until it displaces its own weight of water.

claims.text: Ice at 0 °C has a density of about 0.917 g/cm³ and fresh water at 0 °C about 1.000 g/cm³.
claims.source: CRC Handbook of Chemistry and Physics, 'Properties of ice and supercooled water' (ice Ih 0.9167 g/cm³ at 0 °C) and 'Density of water' (0.99984 g/cm³ at 0 °C). Demo.tsx RHO_ICE = 0.9167, RHO_W = 0.9998.

claims.text: A floating block sinks until the water it pushes aside weighs as much as the block, so the share under water equals the block's density divided by the water's.
claims.source: Archimedes' principle (any introductory physics text, e.g. Halliday, Resnick & Walker, Fundamentals of Physics, ch. 14). Demo.tsx above(rho) = 1 − rho / RHO_W.

claims.text: A floating ice block in fresh water shows about 8% above the water and keeps about 92% under it.
In sea water, which is denser (about 1.025 g/cm³), about 11% of an ice block shows.
claims.source: Surface sea water density about 1.025 g/cm³ (UNESCO equation of state, salinity 35, near 0 °C ≈ 1.028; 1.025 typical). 1 − 0.9167 / 1.025 = 0.106 (node), about 11%. Real icebergs also hold air bubbles and vary.

claims.text: Icebergs hide most of their bulk under water.
claims.source: Follows from c3/c4; NOAA/US National Ice Center: about 90% of an iceberg is below the surface.

recall.question: A block of wax (0.90 g/cm³) floats in water (1.00 g/cm³). About how much of it shows above the water?
recall.why: The share under water equals the block's density over the water's, 0.90, so about 10% shows.
